def model(p):

best=None

    p0=np.random.RandomState(s).randn(7)
    p0[5]=np.random.RandomState(s+100).uniform(-1,3); p0[6]=np.random.RandomState(s+200).uniform(-1,3)
    try:
        r=least_squares(lambda p: model(p)-dA_dt, p0)
        if np.all(np.isfinite(r.fun)) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
